title: Universe-level offset dropped in `IMax` normalization
summary: In `normalize`, the `IMax` case returned `mk_imax(l1, l2)` and dropped the split-off offset; the fix returns `mk_succ(mk_imax(l1, l2), offset)`. A universe of the form `imax _ _ + k` normalized to `imax _ _`, losing the `+k`, so distinct universes were conflated — kernel unsoundness. Pre-stable; fixed Oct 2022.
